research_question: Does the mechanically finite life of Binance USD-M BTC/ETH quarterly delivery futures create a robust, executable delta-neutral basis-convergence edge when the dated future is sufficiently rich seven days before expiry?

economic_mechanism.rationale: A dated futures contract must converge toward its settlement reference as expiry approaches. When a quarterly future trades at a sufficiently positive premium to spot seven days before expiry, a fully collateralized long-spot/short-future pair can harvest convergence without requiring a directional BTC or ETH forecast. This is structurally different from perpetual cash-and-carry because there is a known terminal date and no perpetual funding leg.
materially_distinct_from_prior: Not the previously tested spot-perpetual carry implementation; this uses dated quarterly delivery futures with fixed expiry.
No indicator, momentum, taker-flow, OI, macro-surprise, or listing-event rescue.

universe.expiry_rule: Contract suffix date must be the last Friday of its calendar quarter month; expiry timestamp is 08:00:00 UTC on that date.

timing.signal_snapshot: expiry minus 7 calendar days at 07:59 UTC close, using the last complete 1m bar strictly before entry
timing.entry: expiry minus 7 calendar days at 08:00 UTC open on both spot and dated-future legs
timing.forced_exit: expiry date at 07:45 UTC open on both legs, fifteen minutes before 08:00 UTC expiry

required_per_route: official futures monthly 1m archive covering snapshot, entry and forced-exit timestamps
official exact spot monthly 1m archive covering snapshot, entry and forced-exit timestamps
provider checksum matches downloaded archive SHA256
only timestamp column may be parsed at Source Gate

strategy.collateral_assumption: Spot notional N fully funded plus independent USDT collateral of at least N reserved for the short futures leg; no capital efficiency assumption is used for promotion.
strategy.spot_leg: long exact Binance Spot SYMBOLUSDT at frozen entry open
strategy.future_leg: short equal USD notional of exact quarterly contract at frozen entry open
strategy.notional_matching: Both legs use equal initial USD notional N at entry.
strategy.target_rule: After each complete 1m bar, if close_basis <= 0.001, exit both legs at next minute open.
strategy.stop_rule: After each complete 1m bar, if close_basis >= entry_signal_basis + 0.015, exit both legs at next minute open.
strategy.same_bar_target_stop: If both target and stop predicates are simultaneously true on one completed bar, STOP_FIRST.
strategy.forced_exit_rule: If neither target nor stop has executed earlier, exit both legs at the frozen 07:45 UTC forced-exit open.
strategy.cost_rationale: Base assumes 20 bps spot round-trip plus 10 bps futures round-trip on single-leg notional N; stress increases total pair cost to 50 bps.
strategy.missing_execution_bar: DATA_FAILURE_OR_EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED; never interpolate or use favorable substitute

required_before_shadow: reconfirm base and 50 bps stress costs
liquidation/margin operational review before any micro-live consideration
